description: The line plot illustrates the accuracy@1 (%) of two models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet, as a function of the number of child nodes (tree width), with values ranging from 1 to 7 on the x-axis. The y-axis represents accuracy@1 (%) on a linear scale from 15 to 35. The GPT-4o model, represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, shows a general increasing trend in accuracy, starting at 24.4% at a tree width of 1, rising to 28.9% at a width of 3, peaking at 34.4% at a width of 5, and then decreasing to 31.1% at a width of 7. In contrast, the Claude-3.5-Sonnet model, shown as a dashed purple line with star markers, exhibits a decreasing trend, beginning at 26.7% at a width of 1, dropping to 27.8% at a width of 3, further decreasing to 24.4% at a width of 5, and reaching its lowest point of 20.0% at a width of 7. The two lines intersect between a tree width of 1 and 3, indicating that GPT-4o surpasses Claude-3.5-Sonnet in accuracy at a tree width of 3.
